subclassFeature.name: The Great Wyrm Arcanum
entries: Dragons are creatures of magic, their hearts burning with power older than mortal sorcery. Within you beats an echo of that ancient might, a draconic heart whose power surges through every spell you cast.

Sorcerers who wield the Great Wyrm Arcanum do not merely imitate dragons, nor do they seek to become them. They draw upon the raw arcane power of the dragon within, feeding their spells with its elemental fury and awakening secrets of magic known only to the mightiest wyrms.
As your mastery grows, the power within your heart grows with you, until every spell carries the weight of a dragon's wrath.

subclassFeature.name: Great Wyrm Arcanum Spells
entries: {@i 3rd-level Great Wyrm Arcanum feature}

Whenever your Sorcerer level allows you to learn a new Sorcerer spell, you can choose that spell from any spell list, provided the spell can deal damage of your Dragon Heart damage type, or it is a Draconic Arcanum spell whose name contains the name of your chosen Dragon Heart.
A spell you learn through this feature counts as a Sorcerer spell for you.

subclassFeature.name: Draconic Mantle
entries: {@i 3rd-level Great Wyrm Arcanum feature}
The power of your Dragon Heart radiates outward as a dense mantle of draconic mana, enveloping your body without altering your physical form.
You have Resistance to your Dragon Heart damage type.
While you aren't wearing armor, your Draconic Mantle protects you from harm. Your base Armor Class equals 13 + your Charisma modifier.

You can concentrate the power of your Draconic Mantle around your hands, manifesting elemental claws. When you make an Unarmed Strike with these claws, you can use your Charisma modifier instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls, and the strike deals 1d6 damage of your Dragon Heart damage type instead of its normal damage.

subclassFeature.name: Dragon Heart
entries: {@i 3rd-level Great Wyrm Arcanum feature}

Within your chest beats the heart of a legendary Great Wyrm that perished in an age long forgotten. Though its flesh and bones have long since returned to dust, the heart endured, preserving a fragment of the creature's primordial power, instinct, and ancient will. Choose one heart from the Dragon Heart table. Your choice determines your Dragon Heart damage type or damage types.

When you cast a spell using a spell slot and that spell deals damage to one or more creatures, the spell deals additional damage equal to your Charisma modifier multiplied by the level of the spell slot expended. This additional damage is of your Dragon Heart damage type. If your Dragon Heart has more than one damage type, you choose one of those damage types each time you deal this additional damage. You can deal this additional damage only once per casting of the spell.

subclassFeature.name: Draconic Ascendance
entries: {@i 6th-level Great Wyrm Arcanum feature}
The power of your Dragon Heart intensifies, allowing your draconic magic to overwhelm lesser defenses.
Damage you deal of your Dragon Heart damage type ignores Resistance to that damage type.
In addition, as a Bonus Action, you can extend your Draconic Mantle into a pair of elemental dragon wings.
While the wings are manifested, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover. The wings remain until you dismiss them (no action required), you have the Incapacitated condition, or you die.

subclassFeature.name: Draconic Dominion
entries: {@i 14th-level Great Wyrm Arcanum feature}
Your mastery over the power of your Dragon Heart allows you to command its elemental essence rather than merely endure it.
You have Immunity to your Dragon Heart damage type.
In addition, when you deal damage of your Dragon Heart damage type to a creature that has Immunity to that damage type, you treat that Immunity as Resistance instead.
Whenever you would take damage of your Dragon Heart damage type, you instead regain Hit Points equal to half the damage you would have taken before applying your Immunity.

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you would take damage of your Dragon Heart damage type, you can use your Reaction to draw that elemental power into yourself. You become the sole target of that instance of damage, and the original creature or creatures take none of that damage. You then resolve that damage against yourself as normal, including the healing granted by this feature.
You can use this Reaction a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

subclassFeature.name: Draconic Sovereign
entries: {@i 18th-level Great Wyrm Arcanum feature}

Now you can unleash the full power of your Dragon Heart, causing its elemental essence to erupt from you and take the form of an ancient dragon. This immense draconic avatar envelops your body in densely concentrated elemental power without physically transforming you.
As a Bonus Action, you can assume your Draconic Sovereign form for 1 minute. The form ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), or you die.
While in this form, you gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Sovereign Wings.} You gain the flying benefits of your Draconic Ascendance. In addition, your Speed is doubled.
{@b Absolute Element.} Damage you deal of your Dragon Heart damage type ignores both Resistance and Immunity to that damage type.
{@b Sovereign Transmutation.} Whenever you cast a spell that deals damage, you can change any or all of that spell's damage to your Dragon Heart damage type.
{@b Arcane Supremacy.} You have Advantage on attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast, and the spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 3.
{@b Perfected Sorcery.} Your Sorcerer spell attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 18, 19, or 20.

{@b Great Wyrm Magic.} Whenever you cast a Sorcerer spell that deals damage, you must empower it as though it were cast using a spell slot of the highest level you can cast. If you have a spell slot of that level available, you expend that spell slot. If you don't, you must expend a combination of spell slots and Sorcery Points whose combined levels equal the level of that spell slot. Each Sorcery Point expended in this way counts as one spell-slot level. For the purposes of this spell and your other features, the spell is considered to have been cast using a spell slot of that highest level, regardless of the combination of spell slots and Sorcery Points expended to cast it.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Claw
entries: You manifest the burning claw of Ignivar and slash at one creature within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d12} Fire damage.

When you reach 5th level, you can make two attacks when you cast this spell. You can make three attacks at 11th level and four attacks at 17th level. You can direct these attacks against the same creature or different creatures. Make a separate attack roll for each attack.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Scale

time.condition: which you take when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack or would take damage

entries: You manifest burning scales around the triggering creature. Until the start of your next turn, the target gains a bonus to AC equal to your Charisma modifier and has Resistance to Fire damage. The AC bonus applies against the triggering attack, potentially causing it to miss.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 1, the AC bonus granted by this spell increases by 1, and you can choose one additional creature you can see within range. Each additional target gains the spell's benefits until the start of your next turn.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Fang
entries: You manifest the burning fangs of Ignivar and bite at one creature within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 4d8} Fire damage and is seared by lingering draconic flame.
At the start of the target's next turn, it takes {@damage 2d8} Fire damage, and the spell ends.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 2, the initial damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, and the lingering Fire damage increases by {@damage 1d8}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Tail
entries: You manifest the blazing tail of Ignivar and sweep it through a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d8} Fire damage, is pushed up to 20 feet away from you, and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 3, the damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, the Cone increases by 5 feet, and the distance a creature can be pushed increases by 5 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Wing
entries: You manifest the blazing wings of Ignivar and surge forward. You fly in a straight line up to a distance equal to your Speed. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

As you move, your wings sweep through a 5-foot-wide path centered on your movement. Each creature in that path must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 10d6} Fire damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature can take this damage only once from each casting of this spell.
You must end this movement in an unoccupied space that can support you unless you have a Fly Speed.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 4, the damage increases by {@damage 1d6}, and the width of the path created by your wings increases by 5 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Horn
entries: You manifest the blazing horn of Ignivar and launch yourself at one creature you can see within range. You move in a straight line to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then make a melee spell attack against it.
On a hit, the target takes {@damage 12d10} Fire damage.
The attack scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 5, the damage increases by {@damage 2d10}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Roar
entries: You unleash the terrible roar of Ignivar, filling a 60-foot radius centered on yourself with draconic fury.

Each hostile creature of your choice in the area that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the Frightened condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the creature took Fire damage since its last saving throw against this spell, it has Disadvantage on that saving throw.

Each allied creature of your choice in the area that can hear you is filled with Ignivar's battle fervor for the duration. An affected ally is immune to the Frightened condition. In addition, when it deals damage to a hostile creature, it deals an extra {@damage 2d8} Fire damage to that creature.
When an affected ally reduces a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, it can immediately move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 6, the extra Fire damage granted to allies increases by {@damage 1d8}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Breath
entries: You manifest the apocalyptic breath of Ignivar and unleash it in two successive stages.

entries.name: Incinerating Sweep
entries: You sweep a torrent of dragonfire across a 60-foot Cone. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 10d6} Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The ground and unattended flammable objects throughout the Cone ignite. The area burns until the start of your next turn. A creature that enters the burning area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 4d6} Fire damage.

entries.name: Condensed Breath
entries: Immediately after the Incinerating Sweep, you compress Ignivar's flames into a devastating beam and fire it in a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line originating from you.
Each creature in the Line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 12d12} Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Fire Resistance doesn't reduce the damage dealt by the Condensed Breath. A creature with Immunity to Fire damage instead has Resistance to this damage.

When the beam reaches the end of the Line, or strikes a solid surface that completely blocks its path, it detonates. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d12} Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature can't take damage from both the Line and this explosion from the same casting.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 7, the Incinerating Sweep damage increases by {@damage 2d6}, the Condensed Breath damage increases by {@damage 2d12}, the Line increases in length by 20 feet, and the explosion radius increases by 5 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Sunfall
entries: You manifest a colossal spectral avatar of Ignivar high above a point you can see within range. The avatar draws blazing magical power into its body, compressing the flames until its form burns white-hot like a miniature sun. It then folds its wings and plunges toward the chosen point.

When the avatar strikes, it detonates in a catastrophic solar eruption. Each creature in a 100-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 20d10} Fire damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
Resistance to Fire damage doesn't reduce damage dealt by this spell. A creature with Immunity to Fire damage instead has Resistance to damage dealt by this spell.
A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this spell is utterly incinerated. Its body and nonmagical possessions it is wearing or carrying are reduced to ash, while magic items are left unharmed.
The creature can be restored to life only by magic that doesn't require its corpse or remains.

The impact area remains flooded with white-hot draconic flame for up to 1 minute. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 4d10} Fire damage.
Unattended flammable objects in the area ignite, and the avatar disappears immediately after the impact.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a level 9 spell slot, the initial damage increases by {@damage 2d10}, and the damage dealt by the lingering draconic flame increases by {@damage 1d10}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Ignivar Cataclysm
entries: You summon a colossal avatar of Ignivar in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The avatar is a manifestation of the Great Wyrm's power rather than a creature, and it can't be targeted, damaged, or otherwise affected.

When the avatar appears, choose three different Draconic Arcanum: Ignivar spells of 8th level or lower that you know and that have a casting time of 1 Action. The avatar immediately casts those spells in an order of your choice, resolving each spell completely before casting the next. The avatar disappears after casting the third spell. You can't choose the same spell more than once.

Each chosen spell is resolved as though it were cast using a level 9 spell slot, without expending additional spell slots or requiring additional actions or components. A cantrip chosen in this way uses your level as normal.
Damage dealt by a spell cast through this spell ignores Resistance and Immunity to Fire damage. A creature that would normally be immune to Fire damage takes the damage normally.

The avatar is treated as the origin of each chosen spell for determining its range, area, movement, and direction. Each spell uses your spell attack modifier and spell save DC. You choose the targets, areas, and directions separately for each spell.

If a chosen spell has a duration longer than Instantaneous, you are treated as the caster of that spell after the avatar disappears. You make any choices and can use any actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, or other options granted by that spell for the remainder of its duration.

If an ongoing area or effect would remain centered on or move with the avatar, it instead remains centered on the space where the avatar used that spell after the avatar disappears, unless the spell states otherwise.

While an allied creature is within the blizzard, frost continually reinforces its body. At the start of each of its turns, if it has fewer Temporary Hit Points from this spell than {@dice 2d8} + your Charisma modifier, it gains Temporary Hit Points from this spell equal to {@dice 2d8} + your Charisma modifier.

entries: For each spell slot level above 6, the Speed bonus granted to allies increases by 10 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Fulgaris Breath
entries: You manifest the devastating breath of Fulgaris and unleash a concentrated torrent of lightning in three successive stages.

entries.name: Lightning Lance
entries: You unleash a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line of concentrated lightning originating from you. Each creature in the Line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 12d10} Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Arc Discharge
entries: Immediately after the Lightning Lance, lightning erupts from each creature that took damage from it. Lightning arcs from each such creature to every different creature within 30 feet of it that hasn't already taken damage from the Arc Discharge of this casting.
Each creature struck by this arcing lightning must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d10} Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Judgment Bolt
entries: Immediately after the Arc Discharge, a bolt of lightning crashes down upon every creature that took Lightning damage from the Lightning Lance or Arc Discharge.

Each such creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 3d8} Lightning damage and has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't Paralyzed.
Resistance to Lightning damage doesn't reduce damage dealt by this spell. A creature with Immunity to Lightning damage instead has Resistance to damage dealt by this spell.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 7, the Lightning Lance damage increases by {@damage 2d10}, the Arc Discharge damage increases by {@damage 1d10}, the Judgment Bolt damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, and the length of the Line increases by 20 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Fulgaris Heaven Circuit
entries: You unleash the supreme lightning authority of Fulgaris, causing six colossal pillars of blue-white lightning to descend onto points you can see within range. Each point becomes a Lightning Node for the duration. A Lightning Node occupies its point but isn't a creature or object and can't be damaged or destroyed.

When the Lightning Nodes appear, each hostile creature of your choice within 20 feet of one or more Nodes must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d10} Lightning damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature makes this saving throw only once when the Nodes appear, regardless of how many Nodes are near it.
Resistance to Lightning damage doesn't reduce damage dealt by this spell. A creature with Immunity to Lightning damage instead has Resistance to damage dealt by this spell.

entries.name: Lightning Transit
entries: As a Bonus Action while you are within 10 feet of a Lightning Node, you can transform into living lightning and teleport to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of any other Lightning Node created by this spell.
This teleportation doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks and doesn't require line of sight between the two Nodes.

When you teleport in this way, lightning erupts from both the Node you departed from and the Node you arrived at. Each hostile creature of your choice within 15 feet of either Node must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d10} Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature can take this damage only once from each use of Lightning Transit.

entries.name: Circuit Discharge
entries: Whenever a hostile creature takes Lightning damage from this spell, it becomes Charged until the end of your next turn.

When a Charged creature takes Lightning damage from this spell again, lightning violently arcs from it to every different hostile creature of your choice within 30 feet of it. Each such creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d10} Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
A creature can take damage from Circuit Discharge only once on each turn.

entries.name: Overload
entries: When a creature becomes Charged for the third time during this spell's duration, a massive bolt of lightning immediately strikes it from above. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 6d10} Lightning damage and has the Paralyzed condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't Paralyzed.
After resolving this effect, the number of times that creature has become Charged for the purpose of this Overload resets to 0.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a level 9 spell slot, you create two additional Lightning Nodes, the initial damage increases by {@damage 2d10}, the Lightning Transit damage increases by {@damage 1d10}, the Circuit Discharge damage increases by {@damage 1d10}, and the Overload damage increases by {@damage 2d10}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Fulgaris Cataclysm
entries: You summon a colossal avatar of Fulgaris in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The avatar is a manifestation of the Great Wyrm's power rather than a creature, and it can't be targeted, damaged, or otherwise affected.

When the avatar appears, choose three different Draconic Arcanum: Fulgaris spells of 8th level or lower that you know and that have a casting time of 1 Action. The avatar immediately casts those spells in an order of your choice, resolving each spell completely before casting the next. The avatar disappears after casting the third spell. You can't choose the same spell more than once.

Each chosen spell is resolved as though it were cast using a level 9 spell slot, without expending additional spell slots or requiring additional actions or components. A cantrip chosen in this way uses your level as normal.
Damage dealt by a spell cast through this spell ignores Resistance and Immunity to Lightning damage. A creature that would normally be immune to Lightning damage takes the damage normally.

The avatar is treated as the origin of each chosen spell for determining its range, area, movement, and direction. Each spell uses your spell attack modifier and spell save DC. You choose the targets, areas, and directions separately for each spell.

If a chosen spell has a duration longer than Instantaneous, you are treated as the caster of that spell after the avatar disappears. You make any choices and can use any actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, or other options granted by that spell for the remainder of its duration.

If an ongoing area or effect would remain centered on or move with the avatar, it instead remains centered on the space where the avatar used that spell after the avatar disappears, unless the spell states otherwise.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Vitriovar Claw
entries: You manifest the acid-slick claw of Vitriovar and slash at one creature within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d12} Acid damage.

When you reach 5th level, you can make two attacks when you cast this spell. You can make three attacks at 11th level and four attacks at 17th level. You can direct these attacks against the same creature or different creatures. Make a separate attack roll for each attack.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Vitriovar Scale

time.condition: which you take when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack or would take damage

entries: You manifest black, acid-slick scales around the triggering creature. Until the start of your next turn, the target gains a bonus to AC equal to your Charisma modifier and has Resistance to Acid damage. The AC bonus applies against the triggering attack, potentially causing it to miss.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 1, the AC bonus granted by this spell increases by 1, and you can choose one additional creature you can see within range. Each additional target gains the spell's benefits until the start of your next turn.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Vitriovar Fang
entries: You manifest the enormous fangs of Vitriovar and sink them into one creature within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d8} Acid damage as supernatural acid floods the wound.
On a hit, the target's AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn as the acid eats through armor, scales, hide, and magical protection.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 2, the damage increases by {@damage 1d8}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Vitriovar Tail
entries: You manifest the massive tail of Vitriovar and sweep it through a 30-foot Cone, scattering streams of corrosive acid across everything in its path.

Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d8} Acid damage and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't Prone.

The ground in the Cone is coated in corrosive acid until the start of your next turn and is Difficult Terrain. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 2d8} Acid damage.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 3, the initial damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, the lingering Acid damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, and the size of the Cone increases by 5 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Vitriovar Wing
entries: You manifest the vast, acid-soaked wings of Vitriovar and fly up to a distance equal to your Speed. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Your wings scatter torrents of acid along a 5-foot-wide path centered on your movement. Each creature in the path must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 9d6} Acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature can take this damage only once from each casting of this spell.

The path remains coated in acid until the start of your next turn and is Difficult Terrain. A creature that enters the path for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 3d6} Acid damage.
You must end this movement in an unoccupied space that can support you unless you have a Fly Speed.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 4, the initial damage increases by {@damage 1d6}, the lingering Acid damage increases by {@damage 1d6}, and the width of the path increases by 5 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Vitriovar Horn
entries: You manifest the enormous horn of Vitriovar, its surface dripping with acid capable of dissolving even supernatural defenses. Choose one creature you can see within range. You move to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then make a melee spell attack against it.
On a hit, the target takes {@damage 10d10} Acid damage. The attack scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18-20.
If the target is suffering from a reduction to its AC when you make this attack, the attack deals an additional {@damage 3d10} Acid damage and scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 16-20 instead.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 5, the damage increases by {@damage 2d10}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Vitriovar Roar
entries: You unleash the dreadful roar of Vitriovar. A corrosive black mist erupts from your body and clings to hostile creatures within 60 feet of you.

Each hostile creature of your choice in the area that can hear you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's AC is reduced by 2 for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the creature repeats the saving throw, ending the AC reduction on itself on a success. If the creature took Acid damage since its last saving throw against this spell, it has Disadvantage on that saving throw.

For the duration, whenever a hostile creature affected by this spell takes Acid damage for the first time on a turn, the corrosive mist reacts violently and deals an additional {@damage 2d8} Acid damage to that creature.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 6, the additional Acid damage dealt by the corrosive mist increases by {@damage 1d8}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Vitriovar Breath
entries: You manifest the apocalyptic breath of Vitriovar. You first unleash a concentrated stream of primordial acid before dragging the breath upward into the sky, where it spreads into a vast corrosive cloud.

entries.name: Corrosive Lance
entries: You unleash a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line of concentrated acid originating from you. Each creature in the Line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 12d10} Acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Acid Rain
entries: Immediately after unleashing the Corrosive Lance, you drag the stream upward into the sky. A supernatural cloud forms above a 60-foot-radius area centered on the space you occupied when you cast this spell. The area remains fixed in that space for the duration.

Acid rain continuously pours throughout the area. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d8} Acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Unattended nonmagical objects and structures in the area take the Acid Rain damage automatically.
Resistance to Acid damage doesn't reduce damage dealt by this spell. A creature with Immunity to Acid damage instead has Resistance to damage dealt by this spell.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 7, the Corrosive Lance damage increases by {@damage 2d10}, the Acid Rain damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, the length of the Line increases by 20 feet, and the radius of the Acid Rain increases by 10 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Vitriovar Worldmelt
entries: You invoke the ultimate corrosive authority of Vitriovar at a point you can see within range. The ground ruptures throughout a 100-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point as primordial acid erupts from below, flooding the battlefield and reducing the landscape to a boiling black mire.
When the area appears, each hostile creature in it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 10d10} Acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The ground throughout the area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. Unattended nonmagical objects and structures in the area take the maximum possible damage whenever they take damage from this spell.

entries.name: Dissolution
entries: A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 4d10} Acid damage. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.
At the start of each of your turns after the turn on which you cast this spell, the damage of Dissolution increases by {@damage 1d10}, to a maximum of {@damage 8d10} Acid damage.

entries.name: Corroding Defense
entries: Whenever a hostile creature starts its turn in the area, its AC is reduced by 1 for the remainder of this spell's duration. This reduction is cumulative.
This reduction represents the destruction of armor, scales, hide, magical barriers, and other physical or supernatural defenses and can't be prevented by changing or removing armor.
If a creature's AC is reduced by a total of 3 or more by spells, it becomes Vulnerable to all damage for the remainder of this spell's duration.

entries.name: Total Corrosion
entries: Resistance to Acid damage doesn't reduce damage dealt by this spell. A creature with Immunity to Acid damage instead has Resistance to damage dealt by this spell.

When a creature becomes Vulnerable to all damage through this spell, any Resistance or Immunity it has to damage is suppressed for the remainder of this spell's duration. The creature's Vulnerability then applies normally to damage from any source.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a level 9 spell slot, the initial damage increases by {@damage 2d10}, the Dissolution damage increases by {@damage 1d10}, its maximum Dissolution damage increases to {@damage 10d10}, and the radius of the area increases by 20 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Sylvaris Tail
entries: You sweep Sylvaris's enormous tail through a 30-foot Cone, releasing a cloud of virulent venom. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 6d8} Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A creature that fails the saving throw also contracts Nerveblight for 1 minute. A creature afflicted with Nerveblight has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the Constitution saving throw, ending Nerveblight on a success. Immunity to disease doesn't prevent a creature from contracting Nerveblight.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Sylvaris Wing
entries: You manifest Sylvaris's wings and fly up to your Speed in a direction of your choice without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You leave a 5-foot-wide trail of poisonous spores along your path. Each creature whose space you pass through must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 9d6} Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A creature that fails the saving throw also contracts Mindrot for 1 minute. A creature afflicted with Mindrot has Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat a Constitution saving throw, ending Mindrot on a success. Immunity to disease doesn't prevent a creature from contracting Mindrot.

The poisonous trail remains until the start of your next turn. The trail is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures, and a hostile creature that enters the trail for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 2d6} Poison damage. This damage can be taken only once per turn.
If you end this movement unsupported and lack a Fly Speed, you fall as normal.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Sylvaris Horn
entries: You manifest Sylvaris's venomous horn and charge one creature you can see within range. You move in a straight line toward the target, stopping within 5 feet of it. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@dice 10d10} Poison damage. This attack scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20.

For each different disease caused by your Draconic Arcanum spells currently affecting the target, the attack deals an additional {@damage 3d10} Poison damage. If the target is affected by at least one such disease, this attack instead scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 16–20.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Sylvaris Roar
entries: Sylvaris releases a terrible roar that accelerates the diseases festering inside its prey. Each hostile creature of your choice within a 60-foot radius that is affected by at least one disease caused by your Draconic Arcanum must immediately make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it gains 1 level of Exhaustion.

While this spell lasts, a hostile creature affected by at least one disease caused by your Draconic Arcanum must repeat this saving throw at the start of each of its turns while within the radius. On a failed save, it gains 1 level of Exhaustion. If it is affected by two or more different diseases caused by your Draconic Arcanum, it makes this saving throw with Disadvantage.
A creature can gain Exhaustion from this spell only once per saving throw. This spell has no effect on a creature that isn't affected by a disease caused by your Draconic Arcanum.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Sylvaris Breath
entries: You exhale a thick cloud of virulent spores into a 60-foot Cone. The cloud sinks to the ground, clings to the terrain, and remains in the area for the duration. The cloud lightly obscures its area.

When the cloud appears, each hostile creature in the area is exposed to the disease immediately. A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there is also exposed. A creature can be exposed to this casting only once.

An exposed creature takes {@damage 2d8} Poison damage, becomes Poisoned for 1 minute, and immediately contracts Rotblood, Nerveblight, and Mindrot. It also gains a number of Exhaustion levels equal to the result of a {@dice 1d4} roll. These effects occur without a saving throw to avoid them. The Exhaustion from this spell is inflicted only once per creature per casting.

The diseases caused by this spell last for 24 hours, even if the creature leaves the area or the spell ends. They can be ended early by magic that cures disease. Immunity to disease doesn't prevent a creature from contracting these diseases. Immunity to the Poisoned condition doesn't prevent the creature from becoming Poisoned by this spell, and Resistance or Immunity to Poison damage doesn't prevent its non-damage effects.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Sylvaris Deathmist
entries: You release Sylvaris's most lethal supernatural poison, filling a 100-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you can see within range with dense, dark green mist. The mist spreads around corners and heavily obscures its area for the duration.

entries.name: Lethal Inhalation
entries: When the mist appears, each hostile creature in the area must immediately make three death saving throws, regardless of its current Hit Points.

When a hostile creature enters the area for the first time after this spell is cast, it must immediately make three death saving throws. A creature can be subjected to these initial three death saving throws only once per casting of this spell.
When a hostile creature starts its turn in the area after being subjected to the initial three death saving throws, it must make one additional death saving throw.

entries.name: Accumulating Failures
entries: Record the failed death saving throws a creature makes because of this spell. Successful death saving throws have no effect, don't remove accumulated failures, and don't cause the creature to become stable. A natural 1 counts as two failures, while a natural 20 has no additional effect.

When a creature accumulates three failed death saving throws from this spell, it dies immediately. These failures persist for the duration of the spell, even if the creature leaves the area. All failures accumulated from this spell are removed when the spell ends.

entries.name: Supreme Toxicity
entries: Resistance or Immunity to Poison damage provides no protection against this spell's effects. Immunity to the Poisoned condition doesn't prevent a creature from being affected by this spell. Immunity to disease provides no protection against this spell's death saving throw effects.
This spell's death saving throw effects function regardless of a creature's current Hit Points.

Immunity to disease doesn't prevent diseases caused by these spells, and Immunity to the Poisoned condition or Poison damage doesn't prevent their non-damage effects.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Claw
entries: You manifest the space-distorting claw of Aetherion and slash at one creature within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d12} Force damage.

When you reach 5th level, you can make two attacks when you cast this spell. You can make three attacks at 11th level and four attacks at 17th level. You can direct these attacks against the same creature or different creatures. Make a separate attack roll for each attack.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Scale

time.condition: which you take when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack or would take damage

entries: You manifest space-distorting scales around the triggering creature. Until the start of your next turn, the target gains a bonus to AC equal to your Charisma modifier and has Resistance to Force damage. The AC bonus applies against the triggering attack, potentially causing it to miss.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Fang
entries: You manifest Aetherion's fangs and make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d8} Force damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be knocked Prone as immense gravitational force crushes it against the ground.
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d8} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Tail
entries: You manifest Aetherion's tail and sweep it through a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d8} Force damage, is pushed up to 20 feet directly away from you, and is knocked Prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, the Cone's length increases by 5 feet, and the maximum push distance increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Wing
entries: You manifest Aetherion's wings and fly up to a distance equal to your Speed. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. You fly in a straight line, leaving a spatial distortion along your flight path that is 5 feet wide.

During this flight, you can teleport once to an unoccupied space you can see within a distance equal to your Speed. This teleportation distance is separate from your flying distance and does not reduce the distance you can fly. When you reappear, choose any direction in which to continue flying, and then use any remaining flying distance in a straight line.

Each creature whose space you pass through during your actual flight must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 9d6} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature can be affected by this spell only once, regardless of how many times your flight path passes through its space. Teleportation does not create a damaging path between your departure and arrival spaces.
If you do not have a Flying Speed, you must end this movement on a surface that can support you; otherwise, you fall.
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d6} and the width of the flight path increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Horn
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range. You distort the distance between yourself and the target, rushing in a straight line to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You then make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 10d10} Force damage.
This attack scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20. If the target is Prone or Restrained when you make the attack, the attack instead scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 16–20.
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 2d10} for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Roar
entries: You unleash Aetherion's roar, creating a 120-foot-radius gravitational field centered on you. The field moves with you for the duration.
Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain as immense gravity weighs down their bodies and hinders their movement.

You and allies of your choice within the field become nearly weightless. While within the field, an affected creature's Speed increases by 30 feet, it gains a Flying Speed equal to its Speed and can hover, its long and high jump distances are tripled, and it takes no damage from falling.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Breath
entries: You unleash a continuous beam of compressed space in a 120-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. The beam surges through three consecutive stages during this single casting. entries.name: Spatial Pierce
entries: The first stage deals {@damage 4d12} Force damage as the beam pierces through the target.

entries.name: Spatial Compression
entries: The second stage deals {@damage 5d12} Force damage as space compresses around the target.

entries.name: Spatial Rupture
entries: The third stage deals {@damage 6d12} Force damage as the beam reaches its peak intensity. If a creature fails all three Constitution saving throws, it takes additional Force damage equal to the total damage it took from all three stages. This additional damage requires no saving throw.
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, each stage's damage increases by {@damage 1d12} for each slot level above 7th.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Singularity
entries: You create a miniature black hole at a point you can see within range. The Singularity occupies a 40-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point and lasts for 3 rounds. Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain as space and gravity distort violently around the black hole.

entries.name: Gravitational Collapse
entries: When the Singularity appears and at the start of each hostile creature's turn while it remains within the Sphere, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 6d12} Force damage and is pulled up to 20 feet toward the center. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pulled.
A creature within the Singularity Core is affected by Singularity Core instead of Gravitational Collapse and doesn't take damage from both effects during the same resolution.

entries.name: Singularity Core
entries: The area within 10 feet of the center is the Singularity Core. A creature that enters this area or starts its turn there becomes Restrained by the crushing gravity. While within the Core, a creature automatically fails all Constitution saving throws, regardless of the source or effect that requires the saving throw. This includes Constitution saving throws caused by other spells and effects.

A creature Restrained by this effect has its Speed reduced to 0. It can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC with Disadvantage, ending the Restrained condition on a success. Escaping this condition doesn't prevent the creature from automatically failing Constitution saving throws while it remains within the Core.

When a creature enters the Core for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 10d12} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save. A creature within the Core automatically fails this saving throw and therefore takes the full damage.

entries.name: Final Collapse
entries: At the end of the third round, the Singularity collapses and detonates, releasing its stored gravitational force. Each creature within the Sphere must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 8d12} Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the creature is also pushed up to 40 feet directly away from the center.

A creature within the Singularity Core when it detonates instead takes {@damage 12d12} Force damage. It automatically fails the Constitution saving throw and is pushed up to 40 feet directly away from the center.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Aetherion Cataclysm
entries: You summon a colossal avatar of Aetherion in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The avatar is a manifestation of the Great Wyrm's power rather than a creature, and it can't be targeted, damaged, or otherwise affected.

entries: For each spell slot level above 1, the AC bonus granted by this spell increases by 1, and you can choose one additional creature you can see within range. Each additional target gains the spell's benefits until the start of your next turn.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Umbralis Fang
entries: You manifest Umbralis's death-draining fangs and make a melee spell attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 5d8} Necrotic damage, and it can't regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn. You regain Hit Points equal to half the Necrotic damage dealt to the target.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 2, the damage increases by {@damage 1d8}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Umbralis Tail
entries: You sweep Umbralis's tail through a 30-foot Cone of withering shadow. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d8} Necrotic damage, its Speed is reduced by 20 feet, and it can't regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 3, the damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, and the Cone increases by 5 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Umbralis Wing
entries: You manifest Umbralis's shadowy wings and fly in a straight line up to a distance equal to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Your passage leaves a 5-foot-wide trail of draining darkness that lasts until the start of your next turn.

Each creature whose space you pass through must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 9d6} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails can't regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn. A creature can take this damage only once from each casting of this spell.
The trail is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. A hostile creature that enters the trail for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage.
If you do not have a Fly Speed, you must end this movement on a surface that can support you; otherwise, you fall.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 4, the initial damage and trail damage each increase by {@damage 1d6}, and the trail's width increases by 5 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Umbralis Horn
entries: Choose a creature you can see within range. You rush toward it in a straight line to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 10d10} Necrotic damage.

This attack scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 18–20. If the target is below half its Hit Point maximum, the attack instead scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 16–20 and deals an extra {@damage 3d10} Necrotic damage on a hit.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 5, the initial damage increases by {@damage 2d10}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Umbralis Roar
entries: You unleash Umbralis's deathly roar, creating a 60-foot-radius aura of draining darkness centered on yourself. The aura moves with you for the duration and requires no Concentration.

When the aura appears, each hostile creature of your choice in it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 8d8} Necrotic damage and is Frightened of you for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't Frightened. A Frightened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the condition on itself on a success.

A hostile creature in the aura can't regain Hit Points. Whenever a hostile creature in the aura dies, you or one ally of your choice in the aura gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 6, the initial damage increases by {@damage 1d8}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Umbralis Breath
entries: You exhale an enormous orb of entropic darkness at a point you can see within range. The orb travels to that point and detonates in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 10d10} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A creature that fails this saving throw is cursed by Umbralis for 1 minute. While cursed, it can't regain Hit Points. The curse ends early if the creature is targeted by a spell or other magical effect that ends a curse.

Immediately after the orb detonates, you unleash a concentrated beam of death that targets each creature cursed by this spell. For each target, compare its current Hit Points to a threshold equal to your Sorcerer level multiplied by your Charisma modifier. If the target's current Hit Points are lower than this threshold, it dies instantly. Otherwise, it takes {@damage 12d10} Necrotic damage.
A creature killed by this spell can be restored to life normally by magic capable of doing so.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the damage of both stages increases by {@damage 1d10} for each slot level above 7th.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Umbralis Grave Eclipse
entries: You unleash Umbralis's deathly power in a devastating eruption centered on yourself. Each creature within a 100-foot-radius Sphere centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking {@damage 12d10} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

When the eruption occurs, you create a prison of entropic darkness that encloses the area for the duration. The boundary functions like a Wall of Force, preventing creatures from leaving the enclosed area by ordinary movement. The boundary moves with you, keeping you at its center.

Every creature within the enclosed area becomes cursed by Umbralis for the duration. At the end of each round, each cursed creature loses Hit Points equal to 10 percent of its Hit Point maximum as its life force is gradually consumed. This effect requires no saving throw.
The curse and the boundary end when the spell ends.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, the initial damage increases by {@damage 2d10}, and the radius of the enclosed area increases by 20 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Umbralis Cataclysm
entries: You summon a colossal avatar of Umbralis in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The avatar is a manifestation of the Great Wyrm's power rather than a creature, and it can't be targeted, damaged, or otherwise affected.

When the avatar appears, choose three different Draconic Arcanum: Umbralis spells of 8th level or lower that you know and that have a casting time of 1 Action. The avatar immediately casts those spells in an order of your choice, resolving each spell completely before casting the next. The avatar disappears after casting the third spell. You can't choose the same spell more than once.

Each chosen spell is resolved as though it were cast using a level 9 spell slot, without expending additional spell slots or requiring additional actions or components. A cantrip chosen in this way uses your level as normal.
Damage dealt by a spell cast through this spell ignores Resistance and Immunity to Necrotic damage. A creature that would normally be immune to Necrotic damage takes the damage normally.

The avatar is treated as the origin of each chosen spell for determining its range, area, movement, and direction. Each spell uses your spell attack modifier and spell save DC. You choose the targets, areas, and directions separately for each spell.

If a chosen spell has a duration longer than Instantaneous, you are treated as the caster of that spell after the avatar disappears. You make any choices and can use any actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, or other options granted by that spell for the remainder of its duration.

If an ongoing area or effect would remain centered on or move with the avatar, it instead remains centered on the space where the avatar used that spell after the avatar disappears, unless the spell states otherwise.
A creature that is immune to the Frightened condition can still take damage from these spells, but it doesn't become Frightened.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Terragorn Claw
entries: You manifest the massive claw of Terragorn and tear at one creature within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d12} Slashing damage.

When you reach 5th level, you can make two attacks when you cast this spell. You can make three attacks at 11th level and four attacks at 17th level. You can direct these attacks against the same creature or different creatures. Make a separate attack roll for each attack.

Until the start of your next turn, the target gains a bonus to AC equal to your Charisma modifier and has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. The AC bonus applies against the triggering attack, potentially causing it to miss.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Terragorn Fang
entries: You manifest Terragorn's immense fangs and drive them into one creature within range. Make a melee spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 7d8} Piercing damage.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 2, the damage increases by {@damage 1d8}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Terragorn Tail
entries: You manifest Terragorn's colossal tail and sweep it through a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the area must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 8d8} Bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 20 feet away from you, and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 3, the damage increases by {@damage 1d8}, the Cone increases by 5 feet, and the distance a creature can be pushed increases by 5 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Terragorn Wing
entries: You manifest Terragorn's immense wings and surge forward. You fly in a straight line up to a distance equal to your Speed. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks.

As you move, your wings batter a 5-foot-wide path centered on your movement. Each creature in that path must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 12d6} Bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 20 feet away from you, and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. A creature can take this damage only once from each casting of this spell.
You must end this movement in an unoccupied space that can support you unless you have a Fly Speed.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 4, the damage increases by {@damage 1d6}, and the width of the path created by your wings increases by 5 feet.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Terragorn Horn
entries: You manifest Terragorn's enormous horn and launch yourself at one creature you can see within range. You move in a straight line to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then make a melee spell attack against it.
On a hit, the target takes {@damage 14d10} Piercing damage. The attack scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 15–20.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: For each spell slot level above 5, the damage increases by {@damage 2d10}.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Terragorn Roar
entries: You unleash Terragorn's earth-shaking roar, filling a 60-foot radius centered on yourself with overwhelming terror. Each hostile creature of your choice in the area that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the Frightened condition for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

For the duration, you are protected by Terragorn's Reflective Carapace. If you are targeted by a Magic Missile spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a roll of 1–5, you are unaffected by the spell. On a roll of 6, you are unaffected and the spell is reflected, turning its caster into the target instead.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Terragorn Breath
entries: You unleash Terragorn's devastating breath in a 150-foot Cone. Each creature and each object in the area that isn't being worn or carried must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 12d12} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
On a failed save, a creature also has the Deafened and Frightened conditions until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 2d12} for each slot level above 7, and the Cone increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 7.

spell.name: Draconic Arcanum : Terragorn World Ender
entries: You move up to a distance equal to your Speed. At the end of this movement, you unleash a catastrophic earthquake in a 300-foot Emanation originating from yourself.

Each creature in the area loses Concentration. If a creature is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition. Each creature in the area must also make a Strength saving throw, taking {@damage 20d12} Bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: When you cast this spell using a level 9 spell slot, the damage increases to {@damage 22d12}.
